package main

import (
	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	valv3 "gno.land/r/sys/validators/v3"
)

func main(cur realm) {
	r := valv3.NewValidatorProposalRequest(
		cross(cur),
		[]valv3.ValoperChange{
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1plf3fmy0h4395jcxxh63g7mzeypr06f9yrdk4d"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1078xslm886lv9ad4w5zxxfg8nt07gprk5kwcak"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1l3fmz59rw8l6h29hslxt6gtna3th8s7m5vl88d"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g14m0n559xdj00qwvp6ck0xesprrq26kgprgjt4j"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g187qre9w8v90wp7fhgulwnwegarlulwn2da2gzp"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1thrjnx75dgc95qed7x9edd0rvvpj5d5vevj50h"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g14zqhmnv6mv7h9qle9n2f9wwr4shc73sakr5ssk"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1cm5z4slw83sa3x0gttkvv64nx5dc39n2yxk296"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1e3vld469ekks28mhtd4aqua3mdaz64qgdtz29k"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1n68pkpxxd8klsdv8c3pmu6h9t0uys7fkpspau0"), 0),
			valv3.NewValoperChange(address("g1zlrdlcs65d6yhschadhvlf3qnw9ruelh9rn6wn"), 0),
		},
		"Remove 11 validator(s) from the valset",
		"Batch-remove 11 operator(s) from the active valset.",
	)
	pid := dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), r)
	dao.MustVoteOnProposalSimple(cross(cur), int64(pid), "YES")
	dao.ExecuteProposal(cross(cur), pid)
}
